unit.why: A single narrative, heard from R. Falk, about R. Gershon of Kuty visiting the Besht and learning why the Besht prolongs his Minhah prayer: he elevates the souls of the dead through kavvanot.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מר' פאלק הנ"ל כשנסע ר׳ גרשון
stories.end_quote: הכו אותו שלא ישחק מ הבעש"ט
stories.summary_en: R. Gershon of Kuty, visiting from the Land of Israel, asks the Besht why his Sabbath-eve Minhah is so long. The Besht explains that during his kavvanot thousands of dead souls come to him for tikkun. He gives Gershon the kavvanot in writing; when Gershon uses them, a flock of the dead comes, he faints, and the Besht jokingly has him beaten for mocking him.
